findings.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:17 — P2 confidence 75: `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` makes fallback resolution depend on mutable `SiteSetting.default_locale` while `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:72` caches under `k = "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"` without that dependency, so changing the site default leaves custom-locale requests serving translations from the previous fallback until arbitrary LRU eviction or an explicit reload.

app/controllers/application_controller.rb:159 — P2 confidence 75: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` loads fallback catalogs only after an ApplicationController request sets the locale, so a mailer, job, or other non-controller server-side translation under a non-default locale loads only that locale and returns a missing translation instead of the configured site-locale or English fallback.

goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:17 — P2 confidence 75: `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` makes fallback resolution depend on mutable `SiteSetting.default_locale` while `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:72` caches under `k = "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"` without that dependency, so changing the site default leaves custom-locale requests serving translations from the previous fallback until arbitrary LRU eviction or an explicit reload.

adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real cache invalidation issue. Looking at the diff: (1) FallbackLocaleList.[] in config/initializers/i18n.rb dynamically includes SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym in the fallback chain, (2) The translate_accelerator.rb shows a cache key pattern that includes locale and backend object_id but NOT the site's default_locale setting. When SiteSetting.default_locale changes, cached translations that were resolved using the old fallback chain will continue to be served until cache eviction. This is a legitimate cache coherency bug where the cache key doesn't capture all dependencies that affect the cached value.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/controllers/application_controller.rb:159 — P2 confidence 75: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` loads fallback catalogs only after an ApplicationController request sets the locale, so a mailer, job, or other non-controller server-side translation under a non-default locale loads only that locale and returns a missing translation instead of the configured site-locale or English fallback.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only called in `set_locale` within ApplicationController. The new FallbackLocaleList class in config/initializers/i18n.rb defines `ensure_loaded!` which calls `I18n.ensure_loaded!` for each fallback locale. However, this method is only invoked from the controller's `set_locale` method. Background jobs, mailers, or other non-controller code that uses I18n translations would not trigger this loading mechanism, potentially causing fallback translations to not be available. The diff shows the fallback configuration relies on locales being loaded via `ensure_loaded!`, but this is only called in the controller path.
